<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except first 3)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Create missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': [missing_counts[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'missing_rate': [missing_rates[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'kept': [missing_rates[col] <= 0.30 for col in indicator_cols]
})

# Write missingness report (RFC 4180 compliant - pandas default handles quoting)
missingness_report.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Create selected matrix with only kept indicators
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators
selected_matrix = df[selected_cols].copy()

# Write selected matrix (RFC 4180 compliant - pandas default handles quoting)
selected_matrix.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)

print(f"Total indicators: {len(indicator_cols)}")
print(f"Kept indicators ({len(kept_indicators)}): {kept_indicators}")
print(f"Missingness report written to outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv")
print(f"Selected matrix written to outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
</solution_file>
